item.title: When should a Nordic company move from EOR to its own Italian company?
item.description: The signals that it is time to set up an Italian srl or branch, what the move involves, and how employees transfer without losing seniority.

item.title: RAL vs månadslön: how Italian candidates talk about salary
item.description: Nordic offers quote a monthly salary. Italian offers quote RAL, gross annual pay in 13 or 14 instalments. How to state, compare and negotiate an offer.

item.title: Employer contributions: Sweden 31.42%, Norway 14.1%, Italy around 30%
item.description: The same gross salary costs different amounts in Stockholm, Oslo and Milan. How Italian employer and employee contributions and income tax compare with home.

item.title: The 13th month: why Italian salaries come in more than twelve parts
item.description: Nordic payroll has twelve salaries a year. Italian payroll has thirteen, sometimes fourteen. What the extra months are and how to keep cash flow flat.

item.title: Occupational pension at home, INPS and TFR in Italy: the pension layer explained
item.description: Nordic employers fund pensions through statutory and agreement-based schemes. In Italy the employer pays 23.81% for the state pension, plus the TFR. How to budget it.
